{"reason": "All example failures are truth=demand-forecast-error rows v1 leaves unknown: forecast-bias events with bias 0.065-0.081 just under the 0.1 cutoff, and market-mismatch-only events. Lower the bias threshold to 0.06 and add a market-signal-mismatch branch mapping to demand-forecast-error; this lifts recovery-rate and accuracy without touching the supplier-delay rule.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
          (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.06))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    ((market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
